topics.title: Dinh Cậu

claims.claim: Dinh Cậu is on the rocky headland at the mouth of the Dương Đông river/harbour area in Dương Đông.
The An Giang tourism listing currently shows opening hours 07:00-21:00.
Current visitor-facing sources describe Chúa Ngọc Nương Nương in the principal position with Cậu Tài and Cậu Quý associated/enshrined at Dinh Cậu.

Sources do not fully agree on the exact historical origin and original object(s) of worship. Treat the origin narrative and changes in worship practice as a research question, not a settled single story.
A major annual observance is described on the 15th-16th days of the 10th lunar month.
Recent reporting describes 29 stone steps up to the shrine.

topics.title: Bún quậy Phú Quốc

claims.claim: Multiple tourism sources connect bún quậy to bún tôm from Bình Định / Central Vietnam, later adapted in Phú Quốc.

The date of arrival/development is inconsistent: a Phú Quốc government article says the dish followed Central Vietnamese migrants to the island around 1995-1996, while Vietnam.travel states an earlier arrival in 1955 and later Kiến Xây experimentation from 1996.
A defining practical feature is rice noodles pressed/made fresh at the shop rather than simply using pre-made market noodles.
Common described components include fresh rice noodles, ground shrimp/fish paste and seafood such as squid, plus herbs/scallions and broth; recipes vary by shop.
Because common recipes contain fish and shrimp, fish and crustacean shellfish are relevant allergen flags. Exact recipes and cross-contact vary by restaurant and must be checked on site.
Kiến Xây's operator site currently lists the 28 Bạch Đằng branch as 07:00-23:45.

topics.title: Gỏi cá trích

claims.claim: Local official sources describe herring fillets dressed/cured with lime and eaten in rice paper with herbs, coconut and dipping sauce.
The fish is not heat-cooked in the described preparation; for product design it should be flagged RAW_OR_ACID_CURED rather than simply 'cooked'.

Fish is intrinsic to the dish; official descriptions also include peanuts in common accompaniments/sauce, so fish and peanut are important allergen flags while restaurant recipes still need confirmation.
Local descriptions include mixed herbs/forest leaves, star fruit and grated coconut among common accompaniments.

topics.title: Nước mắm Phú Quốc

claims.claim: Phú Quốc fish sauce is listed by Vietnam's IP authority as geographical indication no. 00001, granted 01/06/2001.
The European Commission registered 'Phú Quốc' as a Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) in 2012 under Implementing Regulation (EU) No 928/2012.
The EU registration dossier describes natural long fermentation of fresh fish in wooden barrels and defines product characteristics and nitrogen levels for the protected product.

The EU dossier specifies labeling information including the name Phú Quốc, product type, PDO indication for export, ingredients, nitrogen quality indication, bottling/expiry and preservation/use information.

The EU dossier defines the protected geographical area around Phú Quốc and specified surrounding Vietnamese territorial waters. Administrative wording in the historical dossier should not be reused as a current administrative description without checking.

topics.title: Tiêu Phú Quốc

claims.claim: The Phú Quốc government portal describes local harvest sorting into red pepper, white/peeled pepper (tiêu sọ) and black pepper.
The same official source describes harvesting in successive ripe batches, primarily by hand.
Local government presents pepper growing as both an economic activity and a cultural/tourism value of Phú Quốc.
The Phú Quốc tourism portal identifies Khu Tượng in Cửa Dương as a notable pepper-growing/visitor area.
A tourism page cites 470 ha and 1,250 tonnes/year for 2007. These figures are historical only and must not be shown as current production.

known_unknowns: Current cultivation area/output and major producing zones.
Named cultivars and agronomic characteristics supported by agricultural/scientific sources.
Whether any current collective mark/GI or other protected-origin scheme applies to pepper and under what exact legal instrument.
next_research: Find 2025-2026 agriculture/statistics sources for current production.
